name: showInlinePadding
label: Show inline padding
description: Show padding on the inline direction, which is left and right in a horizontal writing mode.

name: headerSize
label: Size
description: Use the large size for full-page lists and opt for the medium or small size for those within a more confined space, like a dashboard or playbook.

name: loading
label: Header loading
description: Boolean to determine if the header is in a loading state or not

name: showTitle
label: Show title
description: Show title of the list in the header.

name: enableTitleWrap
label: Wrap title
description: Allow the title to wrap into multiple lines instead of being truncated when it doesn't fit in one line.

name: title
label: Title
description: Title of the list

name: showSubtitle
label: Show subtitle
description: Show subtitle of the list in the header.

name: subtitle
label: Subtitle
description: Subtitle of the list, usually the time it was last refreshed.

name: showCount
label: Show count
description: Show badge for the number of list items.

name: count
label: Count
description: Number to be displayed on the badge, usually the number of items in the list.

name: showPlusSign
label: Show plus sign in count
description: Turn on to display a plus sign next to the record count badge, to convey a rough count

name: showToggle
label: Show toggle
description: Turn on to show a toggle in the header.

name: toggleOn
label: Toggle On
description: Sets the value of the toggle.

name: toggleNote
label: Toggle note
description: Text to be displayed next to the toggle that provides additional information about the toggle to the user.

name: showRefreshButton
label: Allow manual refresh
description: Allow users to manually refresh the list by selecting the Refresh button.

name: updatesCount
label: Updates count
description: Number of updates to be displayed as a badge over the refresh icon

name: showEditColumnsButton
label: Allow field personalization
description: Allow users to choose which fields to display and in what order with the Personalize columns option.

name: areColumnsPersonalized
label: Have columns been personalized
description: Turn on to show an indicator on the edit columns button conveying that customization has occurred

name: showCopyURLButton
label: Show option to copy URL
description: Show option to copy the URL of the list’s current state, not just from the browser.

name: showBackButton
label: Show back button
description: Show option to navigate backwards within the list context, usually to a previous filter or grouping state.

name: showSearchButton
label: Allow keyword search
description: Allow users to search list data with the Search button. This only works for indexed tables.

name: showAiFilterAssist
label: Show AI Filter Assist button
description: Turn on to show the AI Filter Assist button

name: showAiFilterAssistVoiceMic
label: Show voice input in AI Filter Assist
description: Turn on to enable voice input in the AI Filter Assist dialog

name: showConditionBuilderButton
label: Show filter button for condition builder panel
description: Show the filter button that allows users to expand or collapse the condition builder panel.

name: showConditionBuilderPanel
label: Expand condition builder panel
description: Choose whether to expand or collapse the condition builder panel.

name: showFilterOverview
label: Show filter overview
description: Filter overview provides a summary of the filters currently applied to the list.

name: query
label: Query
description: Query applied to the list

name: decodedQuery
label: Decoded query
description: Contains query-related data that is used to render the filter overview component in record list header.

name: fixedDecodedQuery
label: Fixed decoded query
description: Contains fixed query-related data that is used to render the filter overview component in record list header.

name: queryConditionCount
label: Total query count
description: Count of the number of conditions in the query, to be displayed as a badge on the filter button

name: enableSorting
label: Allow sorting
description: Allow users to sort list data with the condition builder. This will display the Sort by button that takes them to the Sort by tab of the condition builder.

name: enableGrouping
label: Allow grouping
description: Allow users to group list data with the condition builder. This will display the Group by button that takes them to the Group by tab of the condition builder.

name: decodedGroupBySortBy
label: Decoded group by and sort by
description: Contains name and label of order by and group by fields

name: showActionBar
label: Show action bar
description: Turn on to show the action bar

name: daModel
label: Declarative action model
description: Object containing the list data needed for declarative actions to execute.

name: actionNodes
label: Actions
description: An array of action nodes that map to buttons and menu items. Each node contains the data needed to display an action

name: aiListConfig
label: AI Configuration
description: Object containing the list data needed for declarative actions to execute.

name: sidePanelState
label: Side panel state
description: State for the side panel, used to toggle Summarize/Hide summary actions in the header.

name: shouldEvaluateDynamicConditions
label: Evaluate dynamic conditions for actions
description: Turn on to allow evaluation of dynamic conditions defined for the present actions. If true, an action with dynamic conditions will only be enabled if all the records selected meet the defined conditions

name: readableFixedQuery
label: Readable fixed query
description: A readable format of current read-only filter conditions applied to the list

name: dynamicConditionsListModel
label: List model for evaluation of dynamic conditions on actions
description: Object containing the list data needed to evaluate dynamic conditions on declarative actions

name: layoutOptionsConfig
label: Layout options
description: Used to display the available options in a layout switcher

name: headerAlertConfig
label: Header alert config
description: Displays an alert message in the header for various statuses of list updates

name: table
label: Table
description: Table name

name: listId
label: List ID
description: The list ID

name: showSaveFilter
label: Show option to save filter
description: Turn on to show the Save Filter option in the filter panel

name: showLoadFilter
label: Show option to saved filters dropdown
description: Turn on to show the saved filters dropdown in the filter panel

name: isListAiChangeTrackerSkillActive
label: Is AI change tracker skill active
description: Indicates whether the AI change tracker skill is active for this list

name: listAiChangeTrackerId
label: AI change tracker ID
description: The sys_id of the AI change tracker record

name: listAiChangeTrackerRestriction
label: AI change tracker restriction
description: Restriction level for the AI change tracker feature

name: isListAiChangeTrackerOriginalQuery
label: Is AI change tracker original query
description: Indicates whether the current query condition matches the original UX List query condition

name: changeTrackerButtonLoading
label: Is AI change tracker button loading
description: Indicates whether the button to enable/disable change-tracker is in loading state
